name: my-rpg-game

scripts.typecheck: (cd shared && bun run typecheck) && (cd apps/server && bun run typecheck) && (cd apps/client && bun run typecheck)
scripts.preview:prod: bun run typecheck && bun --filter client build && bun --filter server exec wrangler dev --env prod
scripts.db:generate: bunx drizzle-kit generate --config=apps/server/drizzle.d1.config.ts && bunx drizzle-kit generate --config=apps/server/drizzle.do.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: bun --filter server exec wrangler d1 migrations apply rpg-global-db-dev --local
scripts.db:migrate:dev: bun --filter server exec wrangler d1 migrations apply rpg-global-db-dev --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: bun --filter server exec wrangler d1 migrations apply rpg-global-db-prod --env prod --remote
scripts.deploy:dev: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run db:migrate:dev && bun --filter client build && bun --filter server exec wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:prod: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run db:migrate:prod && bun --filter client build && bun --filter server exec wrangler deploy --env prod

_comment_overview: Root Bun workspace manifest orchestrating development, testing, typechecking, database migrations, and Cloudflare deployment across apps/client, apps/server, and shared.

_comment_scripts.dev: Runs dev scripts concurrently across all workspace packages.
_comment_scripts.test: Runs the fast unit tests (apps/server/src); needs no running services.
_comment_scripts.typecheck: Typechecks shared, then server (emits declarations), then client (consumes them).
_comment_scripts.preview:prod: Typechecks, builds the client bundle, and runs Wrangler locally against the prod env config.
_comment_scripts.db:generate: Generates Drizzle migrations for both D1 and Durable Object SQLite schemas.
_comment_scripts.db:migrate:local: Applies D1 migrations to local Wrangler state.
_comment_scripts.db:migrate:dev: Applies D1 migrations to the remote dev D1 database.
_comment_scripts.db:migrate:prod: Applies D1 migrations to the remote prod D1 database.
_comment_scripts.deploy:dev: Runs typecheck, tests, remote dev DB migrations, client build, and default Worker deploy.
_comment_scripts.deploy:prod: Runs typecheck, tests, remote prod DB migrations, client build, and prod Worker deploy.
_comment_scripts.test:integration: Boots a real local Worker + Durable Object + D1 per test file (wrangler dev) and runs the integration suites in apps/server/integration; takes about 3 minutes.
